basic_details.job_title: Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Primary Teacher, Music Coach Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok is preparing a panel of Part Time Contractual Teachers for the session 2026-27, for the posts of Primary Teacher (PRT) and Music Coach/Instructor. Registration is through https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ and closes on 22 November 2026 at 05:00 PM. The interview is on 23 November 2026 at Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok. As of 19 November 2026 registration is still open.

content_sections.heading: About KV Gangtok
content_sections.text: Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok is a school in Gangtok. Its notice dated 18.11.2026 is signed by the Principal. The school is preparing a panel of part-time contractual teachers for the session 2026-27, and updates are published on its website, https://gangtok.kvs.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification, as printed: Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known) from a recognized Institute/Board; OR Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) from a recognized Institute/Board. Qualified in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (Paper-I) conducted by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). Proficiency to teach through Hindi and English medium. Desirable: experience of working in a school; knowledge of computer applications. Essential qualification, as printed: Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (Class XII) with 50% marks from a recognized board. Bachelor Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized Institution/University, provided that music subject is studied in all the years of the degree as main subject. Working knowledge of Hindi and English. Candidates having a Diploma in Music are not eligible for this post. Desirable: knowledge of computer applications. Qualifications must be strictly as prescribed, and candidates should not seek equivalence of their qualifications. Where grades are given, equivalent marks of gradation should be attached. Candidates should not fill in qualifications for which the examination result is awaited, withheld, not declared or the marks sheet not received by the last date of submission of applications. The notice does not print experience or age requirements. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice says salary and service conditions are as per KVS Norms and prints no amount. The panel is for the session 2026-27 and the engagement is as part-time contractual teachers. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: KV Gangtok Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints these duties and responsibilities of contractual teachers, for both posts: Regular classroom activity/copy checking. Invigilation duty / evaluation work. Helping students and colleagues in preparation and organization of different curricular/co-curricular activities in the Vidyalaya. All other works assigned by the Principal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KV Gangtok Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register through the link https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ before 22 November 2026, 05:00 PM. Appear for the interview on 23 November 2026 at Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok. Bring a valid identity card, which is needed to enter the Vidyalaya campus on the day of interview. Submit original academic documents on the day of interview. All communications will be done through the given mail ids or whatsapp numbers only. The notice does not print those mail ids or numbers.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice announces an interview for the posts of Primary Teacher and Music Coach on 23 November 2026 at Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok. The reporting time and the marking scheme are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to register for KV Gangtok Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date and time of registration is 22 November 2026 at 05:00 PM, through https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q2. When is the KV Gangtok interview?
faq.answer: The interview for Primary Teacher and Music Coach is on 23 November 2026 at Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangtok.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Primary Teacher (PRT)?
faq.answer: 10+2 with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education or a 4-year B.El.Ed., plus CTET Paper-I qualification and proficiency to teach through Hindi and English medium.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Music Coach/Instructor?
faq.answer: Class XII with 50% marks and a Bachelor Degree in Music/Performing Arts with music studied in all years as main subject, plus working knowledge of Hindi and English.

faq.question: Q5. Can a Diploma in Music holder apply for Music Coach?
faq.answer: No, the notice says candidates having a Diploma in Music are not eligible for the Music Coach/Instructor post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for KV Gangtok contractual teachers?
faq.answer: The notice says salary and service conditions are as per KVS Norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice prepares a panel of Part Time Contractual Teachers for the session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring on the interview day?
faq.answer: Bring a valid identity card for entry into the campus and the original academic documents, with equivalent marks of gradation attached where grades are given.
